name: Swarm Strike [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
You and your allies have trained to overwhelm foes like a swarm of rodents.

Benefit(s): Whenever a foe provokes an attack of opportunity from you, you grant a +1 bonus on attack rolls to each ally who is also currently threatening that foe. This bonus stacks with any other Swarm Strike granted by your allies.
